skill.name: infsh-cli
skill.description: Guide agents to use the inference.sh belt CLI for app discovery, authentication, cloud model execution, and media automation.
skill.summary: Run and inspect inference.sh cloud AI apps from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code using the belt CLI.
skill.author: qu-skills

security_audit.summary: Confirmed risks include remote installer commands, command substitution during manual installation, PATH writes, and cloud app runs that can upload local files. Several findings are false positives because they are documentation links, API-key placeholder text, shell completions, or harmless command examples. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell installation with download, checksum, signature verification, and explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: Manual installation uses shell command substitution to select a download URL.
remediation.suggestion: Publish fixed per-platform commands or verified release URLs, and avoid parsing release data with shell tools.

remediation.issue: The skill can upload local files to remote inference.sh apps.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation that names each local path before any app run that uploads files.

remediation.issue: The manual install moves a downloaded binary into ~/.local/bin.
remediation.suggestion: Document source verification and ask before writing executables into user PATH directories.

remediation.issue: Social media apps can create external account actions.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval for each post, direct message, follow, like, or repost action.

content.user_title: Run inference.sh AI Apps from the CLI
content.value_statement: Teams need one command path for cloud AI models, media tools, search, and app automation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the inference.sh belt CLI.
actual_capabilities: Installs or updates the belt CLI using inference.sh setup instructions.
Authenticates with browser login or INFSH_API_KEY for CI workflows.
Searches, lists, and inspects public and private inference.sh apps.
Runs cloud apps with inline input files or generated sample inputs.
Tracks tasks and saves completed media or JSON outputs.
Uploads local files when app inputs accept file paths.
limitations: Requires the separate belt CLI and an inference.sh account.
May incur inference.sh usage costs or third-party service limits.
Can upload local files to cloud services when paths are provided.
Does not validate app-specific content policies or account permissions.

use_cases.title: Prototype AI Media Pipelines
use_cases.description: Generate images, videos, avatars, and 3D assets without managing local GPU infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Automate Model Testing
use_cases.description: Run sample inputs across public apps and compare task outputs from one CLI workflow.

use_cases.title: Build Account Workflows
use_cases.description: List private apps, check task status, and run approved automations from scripted environments.

prompt_templates.title: Browse Available Apps
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the infsh CLI skill to find image generation apps for product mockups. Summarize the best options before running anything.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare One Model Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Use belt to generate a sample input for falai/flux-dev-lora, explain the fields, then ask before running the app.

prompt_templates.title: Process a Local File
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a safe workflow for upscaling a local image with inference.sh. Identify the file that will be uploaded before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Automate a Multi-Step Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a batch workflow that searches video apps, creates sample inputs, runs the selected app without waiting, and checks task results.

output_examples.input: Find an AI video model for a short product clip.
output: A shortlist of video apps with model names and categories.
A recommended app and the steps needed to prepare sample input.
A confirmation request before spending credits.

output_examples.input: Run image upscaling for a local photo.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the target file, warns that it will upload to inference.sh, and reports the task status and result link.
The output explains whether the task is queued, running, failed, or complete, with the result location when available.

best_practices: Ask before installing the CLI, logging in, spending credits, or posting to external services.
Use generated sample inputs to confirm schemas before each app run.
Name every local file that will be uploaded before executing the command.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installers to a shell without independent verification.
Do not pass secrets or API keys inside prompts or shared logs.
Do not run social media actions without explicit account and content confirmation.

faq.question: What CLI does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses the inference.sh belt CLI to discover apps, run tasks, and check results.

faq.question: Does it need an account?
faq.answer: Yes. Browser login or INFSH_API_KEY is required for authenticated app runs.

faq.question: Can it upload local files?
faq.answer: Yes. File paths can be uploaded when an app input accepts media or other file data.

faq.question: Can it post to X or Twitter?
faq.answer: The referenced apps include X automation. Confirm account, text, and media before any post or direct message.

faq.question: Does it run models locally?
faq.answer: No. The examples run cloud apps through inference.sh, so network access and credits may be required.

faq.question: Is installer execution automatic?
faq.answer: The skill documents installer commands, but agents should request confirmation before installing or updating CLI tools.
